stem:
Landon used a semicircle, a rectangle, and a right triangle to form the figure shown.

Which is the best estimate of the area of the figure in square centimeters?
visual_elements:
A composite figure made of a semicircle, rectangle, and right triangle.
Semicircle diameter: 4 cm
Rectangle dimensions: 6 cm by 4 cm
Right triangle base: 4 cm (10 cm total length minus 6 cm rectangle length) and height: 4 cm
